prompt:
A static medium shot holds on her, seen from the hips up. The camera is locked on a tripod and stays there for the whole shot: the same lens, the same height, the same distance. Keep her position and her distance from the camera exactly as in the image.

She is easy and reassuring: of course there is a metro.

She answers in two short sentences. She speaks towards a point just beyond the right edge of the picture, level with her own eyes. Let her face follow the voice.

Her hands stay at her sides, open and empty, exactly as in the image.

Across her chest we see only the beige trench coat, the plain grey knit of her sweater and the brown leather strap, from the first frame to the last.

On the right of the picture, between her and the edge of the frame, the dark blurred shoulder in the foreground stays exactly as it is in the image, just as blurred, from the first frame to the last.

Finally she stops speaking and smiles and waits. She blinks, she breathes, and she holds that expression the whole time she waits.

Behind her the arrivals hall goes on, warm and soft and out of focus, its travellers small and far away, each continuing on their way. Her eyes rest on a fixed point just beyond the right edge of the frame and stay there for the whole shot.

The framing holds to the very end: in the last frame she is the same size and in the same place in the picture as in the first.
